remarks: Urban Elegance Meets Modern Comfort in Stamford's Premier Condo Complex! Discover a sophisticated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo that redefines city living at the heart of Stamford. This stunning 2007 unit offers an unparalleled urban lifestyle with breathtaking city views and luxurious amenities. Bathed in natural light, the open-concept living space features impressive 9-foot vaulted ceilings and hardwood floors. The gourmet kitchen is a culinary enthusiast's dream, boasting elegant granite countertops, top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, and a stylish center island perfect for casual dining or entertaining. Thoughtfully designed bedrooms include spacious walk-in closets and direct access to a private balcony, allowing residents to enjoy Stamford's vibrant cityscape. The in-unit washer and dryer add convenience to this meticulously planned living space. Building amenities elevate your living experience with a state-of-the-art fitness center, secure underground parking, and a charming courtyard featuring two gas grills-ideal for summer gatherings. Centrally located, this condo provides easy access to downtown Stamford's shops, restaurants, and the convenient train station. This condo offers an unmatched blend of comfort, style, and urban sophistication. Don't miss your chance to call this exceptional space home!
